summary: Creates a smooth polygonal patch from mesh, polygon, NURBS, or Bezier face inputs with selectable basis and connectivity.

key_params.name: polys
key_params.note: Force polygon output rather than mesh output

common_gotchas: Input primitive type and connectivity strongly affect the resulting patch topology.
Clamp and close settings are boundary continuity controls, not general smoothing toggles.
The polys parameter forces polygonal output rather than mesh output and should be explicit when downstream SOPs expect polygons.
key_concepts: Polypatch SOP builds a smooth polygonal patch from supported face or mesh inputs.
The official basis choices are Cardinal and BSpline.
Connectivity can output rows, columns, triangles, quads, alternating triangles, or inherit source connectivity.
Boundary continuity is controlled with close and clamp parameters in U and V.
